paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作中简要提及RFID标签可用于音频感知，但引用标记[23]实际指向一篇关于MEMS陀螺仪识别说话人的论文，而非目标论文。目标论文仅在参考文献中出现，正文未引其工作。

evidences.evidence_quote: MEMS gyroscopes [23] can capture low-frequency acoustic signals (less than 200 Hz) and, using machine learning, identify speaker characteristics with 77% accuracy.
evidences.evidence_context: Alternative signals also offer intriguing solutions for audio perception, such as accelerometer signal in smartphone [1, 14, 19], mechanical signals in magnetic hard disks [17], smartphone camera image stream signals [22], COTS RFID tags [37] and so on. ... Furthermore, MEMS gyroscopes [23] can capture low-frequency acoustic signals (less than 200 Hz) and, using machine learning, identify speaker characteristics with 77% accuracy.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 正文中[23]的引用描述的是MEMS陀螺仪低频声学信号捕捉，与目标论文RFID亚毫米振动感知完全不相关。引用标记匹配错误，判定为误报。 原文证据句引用了其他编号，没有引用目标论文编号。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该论文在正文中引用[23]描述MEMS陀螺仪功能，而非目标论文的RFID亚毫米级振动感知工作，属于引用错误。
